setting.help: Every strategy except 'Qwen only' can send the email text to the OpenAI API.
setting.div: The small AI model on Ollama reads each email. A draft quotation is made when it finds a clear order with enough confidence (see Confidence Threshold). Fast, free and private, but a small model often mistakes a mentioned product for an order: on the project's 150-email test, 29% (qwen3.5:4b) to 76% (qwen2.5:1.5b) of its drafts were wrong. Check every draft. Needs: Ollama.
The large cloud model reads every email. Most accurate, but every email is sent to OpenAI and each one has a cost. Needs: OPENAI_API_KEY on the server.

The small AI reads first; the cloud model decides only for doubtful emails. Choose when to send an email to the cloud: "Confidence below threshold" needs only Ollama and OpenAI; "Kev verification" asks the Kev checker if the answer may be wrong (stricter, needs a Kev server).

The small AI reads first, then simple rules and the Kev checker give a risk score. Risky emails go to the cloud model. Risk budget: "Lowest risk" makes the fewest wrong orders but sends the most emails to the cloud; "About 20% / 30%" sends fewer emails to the cloud. Turn on Local guard to stop fake instructions and questions about old orders before any AI is called. Needs: Ollama, Kev and OpenAI.

Like the local-first risk gate, but first checks that the person writing now asks to buy now. Questions and orders with conditions go to review; clear orders that match the small AI are drafted locally. Risk budget works as for the local-first gate. Turn on "Draft short clear orders locally" to also draft a short instruction such as "Please ship 3 FURN_7800" without waiting for the small AI. Needs: Ollama, Kev and OpenAI.

No small AI: each order line must come from a sentence where the sender asks for that item now, with a quantity. Old, quoted, cancelled or conditional lines are never ordered. Unclear emails go to the cloud model, the rest to review. Turn on "Sort non-orders" to archive emails that need no work, link emails to an open case of the same sender, and flag orders that also ask a question. Needs: OpenAI only for unclear emails.
